title: The Glass Ravine
rumor: The Glass Ravine. A remote ravine contains pools of smooth, dark glass formed by some tremendous ancient heat. Beneath the glass lie the shapes of trees, stones, and perhaps buildings, preserved as though frozen in place. Prospectors have recovered strange fragments there, but tools often break when they attempt to cut through the surface.
first_lead: Cinderhook salvagers occasionally trade small pieces of the black glass in Blackvein.
